name: Alpha Digits

sources.title: Submit App For Review — form and requirements

requirements: iOS and Android apps only — this is an app review blog, not a SaaS directory
For paid apps, developers must provide a promo code (iOS) or .APK file (Android) so reviewers can test
Reviews are editorial: 'we let the quality of the application speak for itself' — expect honest critique, positives and negatives
preparation: Form fields: your name, email, app name, message/description, company name, country, App Store/Play Store link
Promo code (iOS) or APK link (Android) if the app is paid
Note the honeypot: 'If you are human, leave this field blank.'
workflow: Fill all fields, leave the honeypot empty, submit
Team reviews the app; if published, the review runs in the homepage featured section and is pushed to Facebook/Twitter/social bookmarking
watchFor: A paid 'featured review service for a small fee' is mentioned — the standard submit form itself has no price field
The review is genuinely critical — do not submit expecting pure promotion
Web SaaS without a mobile app does not fit this site
countsAsLive: A review post for the app is published on alphadigits.com (homepage featured section / App Reviews category)
unknowns: Price of the paid featured review service
Whether all free submissions get reviewed or only selected ones
